Send Out Sophisticated Messages in Silk Postcards

Silk postcards combine the refined look of matte with the luxurious feel of silk. Coated with soft-touch lamination, they are water- and tear-resistant, giving your message a polished presentation that lasts. Whether you're sending high-end invitations, brand announcements, or promotional mail, silk postcards elevate your design while ensuring it stands up to handling and time.

Silk Postcards FAQs

Q: What makes silk postcards different from matte or gloss?

Silk postcards have a soft-touch lamination that feels like satin and adds water and tear resistance, unlike standard matte or gloss finishes. 

Q: Can I write on silk postcards?

You can write on them with a permanent marker, but for full writability we recommend uncoated cardstock. 

Q: How do I prepare my file for spot UV printing?

Upload a file that has the spot UV section in a separate vector layer. If you can’t prepare the file to have a separate vector layer, contact our customer service and let them know you’re submitting another file with the spot UV section set in a different color.

Q: Can I review my postcards before they’re printed?

Yes, you can review the silk postcards file before it’s sent to production. After uploading the file directly to our site, go to the “Select a Proofing Option” section and choose “Wait – I want to receive and approve a free PDF proof.” We’ll email you a link to the PDF proof and the file will only be sent for printing once you send your approval.

Q: How soon can I receive my silk postcards?

All silk postcards take 6 business days to produce. Your order will be shipped after this printing time. To find out how soon you can receive them, select “Estimate Shipping & Delivery.” Input your ZIP code on the pop-up window and several arrival dates will appear.

Q: Will I save more with bulk printing?

Yes, the larger your order quantity, the lower you spend on each postcard. We recommend printing in bulk if you need to maximize the available budget. The total price and unit rate will appear on the online calculator after you’ve chosen all the specifications.
